ai_summary: Amagi Media Labs reported a robust Q1 FY27, achieving its highest-ever quarterly revenue of INR 437 crores (up 32%) and significant profitability expansion, with Adjusted EBITDA growing 201% to INR 50 crores (11.5% margin) and PAT reaching INR 34 crores, demonstrating substantial operating leverage. The company is actively capitalizing on a large market opportunity, notably with early AI traction (10 active pilots and a major U.S. news network adopting its AI platform), while building strong customer trust through handling mission-critical workloads like the FIFA World Cup. Although gross margins saw a slight year-over-year dip attributed to strategic pricing and mix shifts, this was largely offset by operating leverage in other cost lines and cloud cost savings reinvested into AI for durable long-term growth.
